cohort: 20,965 women with twin births in Sweden between 1995 and 2009, of whom 226 had a PCOS diagnosis
finding: Twin pregnancies in women with PCOS were associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery, particularly spontaneous preterm delivery and very preterm birth, while no significant difference was found for other outcomes like caesarean section, pre-eclampsia, low Apgar score, or perinatal mortality.
